B5.evidence: Not a template where it counts: the crisis copy ('i'm a small app, not a person who can keep you safe right now - but there are people who can'), 'a whole week, kept.', 'noted quietly - no reply', settings groups named 'you / how pip reaches you / your words'. C1.evidence: Progressive disclosure is deliberate: timeline search lives behind one 44px icon with the mood filter row appearing only after it is tapped (TimelineView.tsx:97-104), onboarding is one question per screen, settings is 5 rows in 3 named groups. meditation-pause-light breaks it with four live decisions on the one screen meant to lower a heart rate - close X, 'i feel ready', '4-4-4-4 Box - switch rhythm' and 'pause', five with the Pip+ 3-minute link - and '4-4-4-4 Box' is jargon mid-breath.

C2.evidence: Reads like a friend: 'that sounds heavy.' then 'you don't have to sort it out right now. what's the part sitting with you most?' on thread-light is reflect-then-ask, and nothing scolds a broken streak. Docked: thread-dark.jpg renders Pip's bubbles at --night-bubble-pip #33302A, a neutral grey, while the user's stay #FFCF4D, so the companion goes cold at exactly the hour this app is for; PipAvatar renders the default 'listening' face everywhere, so in thread-crisis-light the avatar beside 'i'm not going anywhere' wears the welcome screen's expression despite expression='concern' existing in PipMascot.tsx.

C3.evidence: Delight is rationed correctly: animate-keepsake-in is reserved for a fresh memory, 'a whole week, kept.' fires only when reflectionCount >= dots.length, and the locked card shows the real date 'Saturday, August 29, 2026' and five line-lengths behind blur-[3px]. The reveal under-delivers: what is revealed is the 'Later,' template, no rendered memory-card state contains a photo despite spec 3.3's photo grid, and both source entries on memory-card-light-full stamp '10:50 PM' so a whole day looks like one minute.

C4.evidence: Capture is genuinely two taps (land in thread, type, send; the mic swaps to ArrowUp once there is text), onboarding is 5 skippable single-decision screens, and the inline paywall is the best-toned money moment in the build ('there are 4 more days of you past the last week', 'not right now', 'cancel anytime - export and delete stay free, always'). Two breaks: the timeline is reachable only from a top-right icon that on the thread is not on screen at all, and settings-subscription is a plan card, ~520px of nothing, 'upgrade to Pip+ ($4.99/mo)' and 'refresh status'.

jury.why: Two advisors opened at or near the Tier A ceiling by restating the gate (one submitted a 93 then revised nine criteria down on peer review), and the round's most consequential defect — the unreachable thread top bar — was missed by three, hedged by one, and confidently refuted by two peer reviewers whose reasoning was plausible and wrong.

summary: A genuinely systematised build with the best-enforced type ramp in the gauntlet and writing that could only be Pip, undone on three specific surfaces: an unreachable thread top bar that leaves the home screen with no door to the payoff, a mail-merged keepsake, and a subscription screen that is 520px of empty cream around a 'refresh status' button — 79.5/100.
